welcome: Welcome to kal-toh. I'll guide you through your first game. You can turn my voice down, or off, under the stone whenever you like.
touchTray: The tan resting at the bottom of the screen is yours to place. Touch it with one finger to pick it up.
dangling: It's dangling from one finger. Put a second finger down, and you'll hold it with both.
danglingAgain: Add a second finger to hold it with both.
holding: Now lay its two ends on two pieces of the structure. Spread your fingers wide, so you can see where the ends land.
blue: Blue means it can rest there. Lift both fingers together to place it.
amber: Amber means it can't rest there. Slide its ends onto two other pieces.
amberAgain: Still amber. Try two other pieces.
droppedDangling: Let go, it falls, and another rises in its place. To lay one, keep that finger down, and add a second, to hold it with both.
droppedOne: You let go before its ends were on two pieces, so it went back to the tray. Keep both fingers down until it glows blue, then lift them together.
missed: It was amber there, so it went back to the tray. Find two pieces where it glows blue, then let go.
placedFirst: Well done. That's your first tan placed.
idle: Take your time. When you're ready, pick up the tan at the bottom of the screen.
turnStone: You can turn the stone by dragging it. Sideways spins it, up and down tilts it.
twoFingerTurn: With two fingers on the stone, twist them to turn it as you see it, and spread them apart to draw nearer.
flipped: This is the underside of the stone. Everything is here: the ways to play, the players, the room, the sound effects, and my voice. Touch any option to change it.
flippedBack: To turn it back over, drag the stone by its rim, outside the carved circle.
chooseWay: Choose a way to play, then touch Shake, or shake your phone, to begin a new game.
wayKaltoh: Next game, the original kal-toh. Touch Shake to begin.
wayForms: Next game, many forms. Touch Shake to begin.
wayZen: Next game, zen. Touch Shake to begin.
translate: The Starfleet delta translates the carving between English and Vulcan.
shakeHint: Shaking your phone also begins a new game.
shaking: Shaking begins a new game. Keep shaking to start over, or hold still to carry on.
startZen: This is zen. Lay each tan across any two pieces. There are no wrong moves here.
zenTen: Every ten tan you place, the whole structure transforms into a new form.
zenComplete: It is fully formed. Shake your phone, or touch Shake under the stone, to begin again.
startKaltoh: This is the original kal-toh. The jumble hides a sphere, built of two shells. Join two tips about one tan apart. True neighbours bring harmony and order. A false pair brings discord, and a tan is shaken loose.
lookKaltoh: Look at the angles where the tan meet. True neighbours make triangles and pentagons.
discord: Discord. Those two weren't true neighbours. The glow now shows where that tip belongs.
aimSame: Both ends are on the same piece. Spread your fingers so they land on two different ones.
aimJoined: Those two tips are already joined. Choose two that aren't.
tooFar: Those tips are too far apart for one tan.
tooNear: Those tips are too close together for one tan.
flung: It was out of balance, so the spin flung it away. Build evenly around the spin.
wobble: It's wobbling. Build on the other side to balance it.
eases: There was no true pair within reach, so the jumble eased itself toward its order.
startForms: This is many forms. A different shape hides in the jumble each game. Look for the angles that repeat, and close its loops one at a time.
aimOuter: Finish the inner form first. The outer shell waits for it.
noise: That was noise, a loose tan that isn't part of the form. It falls away.
struts: Struts brace outward from each loop you close. When the inner form is whole, build the same form again on their tips.
complete: Complete. Beautifully done. Shake to begin again.
twoPlayers: Two players take turns. Pass the phone once your tan is placed. The carving under the stone shows whose turn it is.
voiceLevel: This is how loud I'll be.
form_tetra: It has become a truncated tetrahedron.
form_octa: It has become a truncated octahedron.
form_cube: It has become a truncated cube.
form_prism5: It has become a pentagonal prism.
form_prism6: It has become a hexagonal prism.
form_prism7: It has become a heptagonal prism.
form_prism8: It has become an octagonal prism.
form_anti4: It has become a square antiprism.
form_anti5: It has become a pentagonal antiprism.
form_anti6: It has become a hexagonal antiprism.
form_anti7: It has become a heptagonal antiprism.
form_anti8: It has become an octagonal antiprism.
